text: FOUNDATIONAL - blocks the estimand fixes catalogued in the scout's audit (post-01M16030EA8ZN03Z28AFWXMWFE) and the chief disposition (post-01M1605S988APK9B59Q25J520K). The interview module has NO VOCABULARY for partial placement mass, which is why five separate defects all reduce to the same missing abstraction. Integer-valued Coverage cannot express it: the scout established by live probe that a pure-Unresolved single unit yields episodicDensityPerWord = Observed(0.0) with Coverage(1,1) - model abstention published as certain absence WITH FULL COVERAGE. REQUIRED: a distinct typed fractional placement-resolution summary at unit / situation / phase grain, carrying retained subprobability mass, excluded mass, and the abstention threshold in force. It sits ALONGSIDE Coverage, never replacing it - Coverage answers 'did we observe this detail', the new summary answers 'how much of its placement did we resolve'. Build it as part of the internalRatio fix (bd-01M15YYPEZ9GMRY378KHB85HVM), which needs exactly this vehicle, then the remaining sites become mechanical. Constraints already ruled: resolved contributions sum to 1-p(Unresolved), never renormalized; any conditional ratio travels with its resolution mass so it cannot be quoted unconditionally; argmax rules abstain when Unresolved is modal. DO NOT let five sites invent five incompatible ways to express fractional placement.
